title: Cristy Fermin faces NBI over Claudine Baretto complaint
summary: Veteran showbiz columnist Cristy Fermin faced the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday in connection to the cyberlibel complaint filed by actress Claudine Barretto.
